rules.source: Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019 (Act 9 of 2019) — https://www.ulii.org/akn/ug/act/2019/9
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary of ULII text: protects privacy and personal data by regulating collection and processing, sets data subject rights and obligations of collectors, processors and controllers; gives effect to Article 27(2) of the Constitution; Gazette 3 May 2019.

Search summary of Parliament PDF: assented 14 October 2022; adds s.26C (malicious information, up to seven years or 750 currency points) and s.26D (disguised identity on social media); strengthens unauthorised access and restricts sharing a child's information without parental consent.
